original_unhelpful_note.text: The animation does delay switching, but it is a press check rather than loading the magazine. A press check is pulling the slide slightly to confirm a round is chambered, a common practice for handguns, including striker-fired ones like the Halo Magnum.  https://www.halopedia.org/M6G_magnum
